description: This Python source file contains middleware functions for user authentication in a FastAPI application. It manages extraction and validation of JWT tokens, retrieves user information from the database, and raises HTTP exceptions for invalid or inactive users.

methods.name: User get_current_user( credentials: HTTPAuthorizationCredentials = Depends(security), db: Session = Depends(get_db) )
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current authenticated user from the JWT token, verifies token validity, and fetches user info from the database.

methods.name: User get_current_active_user( current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user) )
methods.description: Asynchronously returns the current active user, effectively an alias for get_current_user.
